title: NIST WebBook: Hydrogen peroxide is H2O2, molecular weight 34.0147 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Hydrogen peroxide as H2O2, molecular weight 34.0147 amu, CAS 7722-84-1.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Hydrogen peroxide, CAS Registry Number 7722-84-1, lists molecular formula H2O2 and molecular weight 34.0147 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 34.00547930326 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/H2O2/c1-2/h1-2H. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
